key_terms: Sector of a Circle: Region bounded by two radii and the intercepted arc (minor vs major sector).
Segment of a Circle: Region bounded by a chord and the subtended arc (minor vs major segment).
Area of sector of angle theta: Area = (theta / 360) * pi * r^2.
Length of an arc of sector of angle theta: Length = (theta / 360) * 2 * pi * r.
Area of minor segment = Area of minor sector - Area of corresponding triangle.
Area of major sector = pi * r^2 - Area of minor sector.
Area of major segment = pi * r^2 - Area of minor segment.
